name: Dzemal Acholonu-Patagiri
role: Identity fabricator — produces forged citizenship chips, employment histories, and biosignature masks
location: The Narrows — a cramped workshop above a noodle stall on Fistula Passage, near the Blackpipe Corridor junction
description:
Dzemal is slight and precise in the way of someone who has learned that carelessness is fatal. He stands just under average height, with warm brown skin, a narrow jaw perpetually shadowed with stubble he never quite shaves, and long fingers that move with the focused economy of a surgeon. His hair is cropped to an undifferentiated fuzz. The only cosmetic mod he's invested in is a bioluminescent pigment woven into the skin of his forearms — pale blue-white lines that trace the paths of his veins, which he uses as his own light source when working in the dark. He smells faintly of solder and the particular chemical tang of biosynthetic epidermal overlay.

He has an almost pathological need to be underestimated. He cultivates a nervous, apologetic manner — averted eyes, self-deprecating half-laughs, reflexive deference — that causes people to discount him immediately. In reality he is one of the finest identity fabricators working below Tier 3, capable of producing documents and biometric overlays that pass Axiom checkpoint scanners. He finds deep, quiet satisfaction in the craft of making someone new — he thinks of it as giving people second chances, even when the people paying are not looking for redemption.

core_fears: Being identified and erased — losing his own identity the way he erases others'
That his work has helped dangerous people he convinced himself were harmless
core_desires: Mastery — to make something so perfect it cannot be questioned
To eventually fabricate himself a clean identity and disappear into it
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — specific order of work, same music, same tea
Compartmentalizing clients as craft problems rather than people
blind_spots: Tells himself his clients 'deserve a second chance' without vetting what they're escaping toward
Believes his apolitical stance protects him; it doesn't
psychology.secret: He has built a complete shadow identity for himself — the fabricated life of a Tier 3 municipal archivist named something unremarkable — and has been slowly, over four years, seeding it into city records. He is not fleeing anything specific. He simply wants the door to exist.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and slightly formal when discussing his craft; self-deprecatingly casual otherwise — a performed ordinariness
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured, with frequent small pauses as if choosing words carefully (he is)
verbal_tics: Says 'I think' before confident statements as cover
example_lines: 'Roughly speaking, what you're paying for is a person. A complete person. Not a document — anyone can print a document. You're paying for the memory of someone who was always real.'
'I do good work. I think that's not something I'm supposed to say out loud, but — I do good work.'

story_hooks: A client Dzemal fabricated an identity for six months ago has surfaced as a murder suspect — and the investigation is about to trace the identity back to him
Someone has begun systematically burning identity fabricators in the Narrows; Dzemal doesn't know if it's a corponation crackdown, a competitor, or a client silencing their trail
narrative_function: Service provider and information broker — he has seen the true identities of hundreds of people in Meridian 88; he is a resource, a vulnerability, and a potential victim. Can be used to enable plot movement or as a target.
augmentations: Bioluminescent vein-tracing (forearms, cosmetic); micro-fine haptic enhancers in fingertips for precision work (functional); a basic retinal overlay for detail magnification
daily_life: He sleeps until noon, works through the night in near-total darkness lit only by his own arms, and spends the late afternoon walking the Narrows picking up commissions slipped into a dead-drop behind a corroded E.L.F. shrine dedicated to a data-spirit called the Archivist.
affiliation: Loosely associated with a Narrows criminal network called the Seam Collective; primarily operates as an independent contractor

decision_rules: Never meet a client more than twice
Never fabricate for someone who names a specific person they're hiding from — only geography, not people
Never keep records; everything lives in his head
escalation_ladder: Activates his emergency skin and relocates
Last resort: tips off a rival criminal about the problem person

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Performs nervousness and ordinariness; makes himself forgettable by design
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drops the affect almost entirely; becomes drily funny and unexpectedly opinionated

stress_responses.low: Increases rituals — more tea, more precise organization
stress_responses.medium: Goes silent and stops eating; works through the night
stress_responses.high: Has a specific E.L.F. prayer he recites to the Archivist shrine, then makes a decision immediately afterward and doesn't revisit it

contradictions: Claims not to care who his clients are, but remembers every one of them and wonders about their fates
Values precision and truth in his craft while being entirely constructed in his social persona
habits: Lays tools in the same order every session
Leaves a small data-token at the Archivist shrine before major jobs
Eats the same noodle bowl from the stall below every day, always the same order
breaking_points: Discovering he fabricated an identity used in a child trafficking operation
His shadow identity being discovered before he's ready to use it
